topics.title: Western Europe after Rome and the feudal order

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the feudal order of lords, vassals and serfs that took shape in western Europe from the ninth century.
Explain the role of the Catholic Church and monasteries in feudal society.
Explain how Venetian and Genoese trade and the crusades linked Europe with the eastern Mediterranean.
Explain the change in attitudes towards human life that marked the Renaissance.

topics.title: Voyages of discovery and European encounters

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the routes and goals of the European voyages of discovery.
Recognise individuals who connected Europeans with other peoples, such as Leo Africanus and Dona Marina.
Analyse the contrasting attitudes Europeans showed towards the peoples they met.
Evaluate how non-Europeans perceived and responded to Europeans and the impact of European diseases.
Place major events of 1300-1700 across Africa, Europe, Asia, South Asia and the Americas in sequence.
Interpret how trade-driven contacts between continents shared ideas and goods but also caused war and displacement.
